items.title_orig: The October 1992 dismemberment murder of 19 year old college student Diana Vicari from Tucson, Arizona
items.article_text:
Diana Vicari was just 19 years old when she became a victim of a brutal dismemberment murder in Tucson, Arizona. 
 It was Thursday October 22, 1992.
 Diana left her Pima Community College drama course taught by Robert Encila at around 9:30 PM. Her roommate confirmed she briefly returned home to her apartment in the 3200 Block of East Seneca Street and then drove off in her silver 1981 Ford Mustang.
 Witnesses at the now shuttered New Orleans Lounge bar located on Oracle Rd between Wetmore and Limberlost (now a Burlington Coat Factory) reported she briefly was allowed in the bar by doorman Tim Storm to see employees Troy Olson and John Mazur.
